name: XWF World Championship
epitaph: Changed hands once in the surviving record, in a triple-threat ankle-breaker match that put both the World and Submission titles on the line at once.

name: XWF Submission Championship
epitaph: Changed hands once in the surviving record, unified onto the same night's World title change in a triple-threat ankle-breaker match.

name: XWF Extreme Championship
epitaph: Changed hands once in the surviving record, in an outdoor buried-alive match voted the promotion's own greatest match of all time.
